issues.title: Sign Windows releases with SignPath Foundation
issues.body:
## Context
We applied to the SignPath Foundation (free code signing for OSS) on 2026-10-06. It was **declined on 2026-10-07**: the project does not yet show enough public visibility (GitHub stars/forks/contributors, external articles or discussions). They welcome a re-application later, or a paid SignPath subscription (https://docs.signpath.io/change-subscription). Releases stay unsigned (SmartScreen shows "unknown publisher") until then. The Microsoft Store (MSIX) is the alternative that needs no certificate.

## Work (when we revisit)
- [ ] Re-apply once the project has gained traction (stars, forks, mentions)
- [ ] Or evaluate the paid subscription
- [ ] Add the SignPath integration in `.github/workflows/release.yml` at the `TODO(code signing)` step
- [ ] Update `CODE_SIGNING.md`, README and the website

## Acceptance criteria
- Setup and Portable exes in the GitHub Release are signed

## Notes
The bundled ffmpeg is GPLv3 (separate process); see `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.

issues.title: Stop shipping ffmpeg twice (shrink the installer)
issues.body:
## Context
`ffmpeg.exe` is packed both as an extra resource (`resources/ffmpeg.exe`) and inside `app.asar.unpacked/node_modules/ffmpeg-static/`. The installer is ~142 MB; `dist/win-unpacked` is 183 MB.

## Proposal
Exclude `node_modules/ffmpeg-static/ffmpeg.exe` from the app files (or drop the extra resource) and make `resolveFfmpeg()` in `src/thumbs.js` find the single copy in the packaged app.

## Acceptance criteria
- Only one ffmpeg.exe in the packaged output
- Thumbnails, previews, media info and Verify file work from the **packaged** app (not just `npm start`)
- ffmpeg license/README still shipped (see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)

issues.title: Portable build: keep data next to the exe
issues.body:
## Context
The portable exe still stores `catalog.db`, thumbnails and settings under `%APPDATA%`, so it isn't truly portable (e.g. run from a USB stick).

## Proposal
When running as the electron-builder portable target (`PORTABLE_EXECUTABLE_DIR` is set) use `<exe dir>/DiskcorderData` as `userData`. Keep the installed build unchanged.

## Acceptance criteria
- Portable exe creates and reads its data next to itself
- Installed build keeps using `%APPDATA%`
- README documents the behavior

issues.title: Automated test suite (transfer, backup, thumbnails, db) running in CI
issues.body:
## Context
There is no automated test suite. During the 2026-10-06 review we verified transfer, backup, thumbnails and the UI with throw-away scripts; they should become permanent tests.

## Scope
- [ ] Use the Node test runner (`node --test`), no new dependencies
- [ ] `transfer.js`: copy/move/replace/skip/keep-both, cancel cleanup, replace+cancel keeps the old version, move keeps the source on size mismatch
- [ ] `backup.js`: first run, skip unchanged, update changed, cancel keeps good copy, no `.diskcorder-part` leftovers
- [ ] `thumbs.js`: `pickBestTimestamp` avoids a black intro, `probeInfo` parsing, concurrency cap, abort leaves no part files (generate fixtures with ffmpeg-static)
- [ ] `db.js`: replaceVolume keeps notes/aliases/tags, migrations, LIKE escaping
- [ ] `safeJoin`/`isInside` path-validation cases (`..`, absolute paths, drive root)
- [ ] Run in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`

## Acceptance criteria
`npm test` passes locally and in CI; tests use temp dirs only (never real drives).

issues.title: Smoke-test the packaged app in CI (electron-builder --dir)
issues.body:
## Context
Release problems (native module rebuild, missing resources) only show up when the tag workflow runs.

## Proposal
Add a CI job on `windows-latest` that runs `npx electron-builder --win --dir`, checks that `resources/ffmpeg.exe`, the ffmpeg license and `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` exist, and starts the exe for a few seconds.

## Acceptance criteria
A broken packaging config fails the PR check instead of the release.

issues.title: Opt-in auto-generation of thumbnails when a drive connects
issues.body:
## Context
Auto-generation was disabled in commit 7843ebb because of crashes. Likely causes were fixed on 2026-10-06 (ffmpeg concurrency capped at 3, jobs de-duplicated, atomic outputs, timeouts), but it hasn't had real-world testing.

## Proposal
- Add a setting "Generate thumbnails automatically when a drive connects" (default **off**)
- Reuse the existing resumable batch; show progress in the ops drawer; pause on low battery/while copying is optional

## Acceptance criteria
- Setting persists
- With it on, connecting a large drive does not freeze or crash the app
- Cancel/pause work

issues.title: Choose a destination subfolder for copy / move
issues.body:
## Context
Copy/move always lands at the root of the target drive.

## Proposal
In the copy/move dialog let the user pick (or type) a destination folder on the target drive, using the catalog's folder tree; default stays the root. Validate with `safeJoin`.

## Acceptance criteria
- Item ends up in the chosen folder; conflicts handled as today
- Path can't escape the drive root
- Remembers the last destination per drive (optional)

issues.title: Update the catalog live after copy / move
issues.body:
## Context
After a copy/move the destination catalog isn't updated until the user re-scans.

## Proposal
Insert (copy) or re-parent (move) the affected entries in SQLite right after a successful transfer, keeping notes/tags for moved items, and refresh the visible listing.

## Acceptance criteria
- Copied/moved items appear immediately in the destination and disappear from the source on move
- Folder `tree_size` roll-ups are updated
- Covered by tests

issues.title: Content-hash duplicate detection
issues.body:
## Context
Duplicates are matched by name + size, which can false-positive (and misses renamed copies).

## Proposal
Optionally confirm candidates by hashing content when the drive is connected (partial hash first: size + first/last MB, then full hash on request). Store hashes in the catalog so offline comparison works. Progress + cancel in the ops drawer.

## Acceptance criteria
- Duplicates tab can show "verified identical" vs "same name+size"
- Hashing is cancelable and doesn't block the UI
- The existing guard (never delete every copy) still applies

issues.title: "Missing files since last scan" (diff on re-scan)
issues.body:
## Context
Re-scanning/updating a drive silently replaces the catalog; users can't see what disappeared or changed.

## Proposal
On Update, compute added / removed / changed entries versus the previous catalog and show a summary (with a list) after the scan. Keep notes/tags of removed entries recoverable for the session.

## Acceptance criteria
- Summary after Update: N added, N removed, N changed
- Clicking the summary lists the files

issues.title: Faster search for very large catalogs (FTS5 / trigram)
issues.body:
## Context
Search uses escaped `LIKE` over names, notes, aliases and tags. Fine today; will slow down on catalogs with millions of rows.

## Proposal
Benchmark first. If needed move to SQLite FTS5 (trigram tokenizer) keeping substring semantics, with a migration and rebuild step.

## Acceptance criteria
- Benchmark on a synthetic 1M-entry catalog documented in the PR
- Search behavior (substring, case-insensitive, scoped to drive) unchanged

issues.title: Recognize drives by volume serial number
issues.body:
## Context
Drives are matched by saved root path / the `.diskcorder-id` marker file. If the drive letter changes or the marker is missing, the drive shows as offline.

## Proposal
Read the Windows volume serial (and label) and use it as a fallback fingerprint to re-detect a drive on a different letter.

## Acceptance criteria
A mapped drive plugged in under a new letter is detected as connected without re-mapping.

issues.title: File lists silently stop at 20,000 entries
issues.body:
## Context
`listFiles`, `listFilesUnder` and `listFlagged` in `src/db.js` use a hard `LIMIT 20000`; List/Gallery views for big drives are truncated without any hint.

## Proposal
Either page results (load more on scroll) or show a visible "showing first 20,000 of N" notice with a way to narrow down.

## Acceptance criteria
- User can tell when a list is truncated or can reach all entries
- Large drives remain responsive

issues.title: Replace blocking fs.existsSync calls in IPC handlers
issues.body:
## Context
Several handlers in `src/main.js` call `fs.existsSync` on drive paths. On a disconnected or slow network drive this blocks the main process and freezes the UI.

## Proposal
Use `fsp.access`/`fsp.stat` with a timeout helper. Keep reachability checks cheap (the periodic check already exists).

## Acceptance criteria
Unplugging a drive or a stalled network path never freezes the window.

issues.title: Thumbnail progress bar can update a transfer row
issues.body:
## Context
`onThumbProgress` in `src/renderer/renderer.js` updates the first `.op-row` in the ops drawer. If a copy/move/backup is running at the same time, the thumbnail progress can overwrite that row.

## Fix
Tag op rows by operation id/kind and update the matching one.

## Acceptance criteria
Running a transfer and a thumbnail batch together shows two independent, correct rows.

issues.title: Export of thumbnails loads everything into memory
issues.body:
## Context
`exportThumbs` in `src/thumbs.js` base64-encodes all thumbnails into one JSON object, which can use a lot of memory for big catalogs.

## Proposal
Stream the export (NDJSON or a zip) and import incrementally. Keep import of the old format.

## Acceptance criteria
Exporting a drive with 50k thumbnails stays within a reasonable memory ceiling; old exports still import.

issues.title: Don't lower user_version when opening a newer database
issues.body:
## Context
`runMigrations` in `src/db.js` writes `user_version` back down if an older app version opens a database created by a newer one, which can cause migrations to re-run later.

## Proposal
If the DB version is newer than the app supports, refuse to open it with a clear message (or open read-only) instead of downgrading.

## Acceptance criteria
Opening a newer DB never alters its `user_version`; the user sees an explanatory message.

issues.title: Test symbolic-link behavior and the Gallery multi-select layout
issues.body:
## Context
Two things from the 2026-10-06 test pass could not be verified:
- Moving a folder that contains symlinks should copy the rest, keep the original and show a message (no privilege to create symlinks on the test machine).
- The multi-select checkbox position in the new Gallery grid cards was never checked visually.

## Work
- [ ] Test the symlink case on a machine/CI runner that can create symlinks (add to the automated tests where possible)
- [ ] Open Gallery, enable Select, and verify the checkbox and star don't overlap or hide the thumbnail; fix CSS if needed

issues.title: Accessibility & readability pass 2: font sizes and remaining hard-coded colors
issues.body:
## Context
The contrast pass (2026-10-06) only changed theme tokens and was checked on empty states plus a few views. About 47 rules use 9-11px fonts, and some views may still use hard-coded colors.

## Work
- [ ] Review Space map, Duplicates, Large files, Backup, Test Drive, modals and the tutorial with real data in all three themes
- [ ] Raise the smallest font sizes (min ~11-12px for body text)
- [ ] Replace hard-coded colors with tokens; check treemap label contrast
- [ ] Keyboard focus visible on all controls

## Acceptance criteria
Text/background pairs meet 4.5:1 in dark, blue and light themes.

issues.title: Website: realistic screenshots and expressionrise.com project card
issues.body:
## Context
The screenshots on the website (`site/assets/`) were taken from synthetic test data (colored test patterns, a drive named "Diskcorder Test Drive").

## Work
- [ ] Retake screenshots with realistic sample content (non-copyrighted footage/photos), all three themes optional
- [ ] Add the project card/links to https://expressionrise.com/ (snippet is in the PR notes)
- [ ] Add repo topics: electron, sqlite, usb, video, disk-catalog
- [ ] Link Setup and Portable downloads directly on the site

issues.title: Research: macOS and Linux support
issues.body:
## Context
The app is Windows-only today (ffmpeg.exe resource, drive-letter assumptions, NSIS/portable targets).

## Questions
- What breaks on macOS/Linux (paths, `ffmpeg-static` binaries, volume detection, reachability checks, Open in Explorer)?
- Build targets (dmg/AppImage) and signing/notarization effort?
- Is there demand? (gather feedback in this issue)

## Deliverable
A short write-up with an estimate; no code required.

issues.title: Localization (Polish UI)
issues.body:
## Context
All UI strings are English and inline in `renderer.js`/`index.html`.

## Proposal
Extract strings into a small dictionary (no framework), add a language switch in settings, ship Polish first.

## Acceptance criteria
- Language persists; falls back to English for missing keys
- Contributors can add a language by adding one file

issues.title: Save the catalog onto the drive (opt-in sidecar file)
issues.body:
## Context
The catalog lives only in the app database. A copy stored on the drive itself would travel with it (open it on another PC) and act as a backup of notes/tags.

## Proposal
- Hidden file `.diskcorder/catalog.json` in the drive root, built from the existing export (thumbnails optional - they are large). Written to a temp file and renamed, cancelable, never destroys the previous version.
- **Always ask** before writing to a drive (orange-framed modal, like the destructive-action warnings), after a scan/Update, plus a manual "Save catalog to this drive" action. "Do not ask again for this drive" is an explicit opt-in only.
- **On exit**: no silent writes. If the catalog has unsaved changes and the drive is still connected, ask "Update the catalog on X?" with Save / Skip / Cancel. No changes = quit immediately.
- **Conflicts**: store a timestamp + machine id; when a connected drive holds a newer catalog than the local one, ask whether to load it.
- Handle read-only/full/missing drives with a clear message (never block quitting).
- Update the website FAQ and README: scanning still only reads; writing the sidecar is opt-in.

## Acceptance criteria
- Nothing is written to a drive without an explicit yes
- Interrupting a save leaves the previous catalog file intact
- Two machines editing the same drive never silently overwrite each other
- Tested on a throw-away drive only

issues.title: Publish to the Microsoft Store (MSIX)
issues.body:
## Context
SignPath declined us for now (see the signing issue). Packages submitted to the Microsoft Store are signed by Microsoft, so no own certificate is needed, and SmartScreen does not warn for Store installs.

## Work
- [ ] Create a Partner Center developer account (individual; check current fee) and reserve the app name
- [ ] Add an `appx` (MSIX) target to electron-builder with the identity name/publisher from Partner Center; `runFullTrust` so external drives stay accessible
- [ ] Build the MSIX in `release.yml` next to Setup and Portable
- [ ] Privacy policy (everything stays local), store listing, screenshots, age rating
- [ ] Mention the bundled GPLv3 ffmpeg in the listing and `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`
- [ ] Pass certification and verify install/update/uninstall

## Acceptance criteria
- Diskcorder installs from the Microsoft Store and can read/write external drives
- Do this after the automated test suite is in place

issues.title: Check the delete/move/replace warning frames in all themes
issues.body:
## Context
Delete, Move and Replace confirmations now have an orange frame and a warning banner (`.modal.warn`, `.modal-warning`, token `--warn` with fallback `#f0a828`); the About window and the detail pane also warn that the app can delete files. Not yet checked visually.

## Work
- [ ] Open every destructive confirmation (Delete, bulk delete in Duplicates, Move, Copy + Replace) in the dark, blue and light themes; fix contrast of the frame/banner text
- [ ] Decide whether to add a one-time first-run notice that the app can delete files

## Acceptance criteria
- Banner text meets 4.5:1 in all three themes; nothing destructive lacks the orange frame
